laws.name: function_admission_exact
laws.exact: identifierPresent and bodyPresent and not functionConflict and not importConflict and not otherBindingConflict
laws.reason: a missing or shadowed declaration must not become a complete function artifact

laws.name: arrow_admission_exact
laws.exact: not functionConflict and not importConflict and not otherBindingConflict
laws.reason: callable-value roots must preserve collision rejection

laws.name: type_admission_exact
laws.exact: identifierPresent and not typeConflict and not importConflict
laws.reason: duplicate or imported type names cannot silently overwrite evidence

laws.name: type_kind_exact
laws.exact: Interface if interfaceSyntax else TypeAlias if aliasSyntax else Ignore
laws.reason: preserve interface precedence including contradictory conditional facts

laws.name: root_result_exact
laws.exact: Complete if collectionSucceeded else DeclarationLimit if limitExceeded else Unsupported
laws.reason: retain explicit declaration-limit result and empty maps instead of claiming reviewable partial evidence

preserve exceptions for outer catch, no new normalization inside binders
